name: Power Grid
description: Bitcoin mining tycoon game — learn how mining really works
extendedDescription:
Power Grid – Bitcoin Mining Tycoon

Power Grid is a browser tycoon game (think RollerCoaster Tycoon, but for Bitcoin mining) that teaches how mining really works. You start with one container of Antminer S19s on a 250 kW grid hookup and climb the power ladder — diesel, gas, coal, solar, wind, hydro, fission, geothermal, orbital solar, fusion — all the way to the (admittedly impossible) free energy core.

It runs on real numbers: live BTC price, network hashrate, block height, difficulty retargets and fees. Survive halvings, heatwaves, brownouts, curtailment calls, price crashes and raiders.

What you can do:
 Run a mining site in six real locations (Texas, Iceland, Paraguay, Ethiopia, Bhutan, North Dakota), each with real power prices and risks
 Buy and sell real miner models (S19j Pro, S19 XP, S21, S21 XP Hydro) with real J/TH efficiency and payback math
 Unlock 49 "ledger" cards explaining real mining concepts: proof of work, difficulty, pool luck, PPLNS, fee markets, hashprice, demand response, curtailment
 Explore a built-in mempool visualiser and block explorer, and build a block by hand to learn fee rate vs fee
 Replay history: Winter Storm Uri (2021), the China ban migration (2021), crypto winter (2022), the fourth halving (2024)
 Free, no ads, no tracking, plays offline once loaded, saves stay in the browser
 Built-in pay-what-you-want Lightning tip jar

Open source (Rust + WebAssembly), fully responsive on mobile. Pairs well with the other education mini apps (Kit Bitcoin, Bitcoin Interactive Thailand).
